items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Well, he made a little session with us

ctx.x: He was -- he did quite a few things that were fast. He was real fast. Well, he made a little session with us, and, oh, I've forgotten what label they were on. And of course, during this time Red was a member of

Fletcher's band, and he was one of the musicians that we talked about that never traveled extensively, in fact had never been on the road on one nighters like Fletcher traveled, you know, doing 35 one nighters in a row, you know, like we played out in Nebraska and all around. There was a chain of ballrooms out in Nebraska during that time. I think you might recall this. There was a guy named Tom Archer that had a lot of ballrooms, like an agency in Mason City, Iowa; in Minneapolis, Minnesota; and Des Moines,…
